_comment: Offline jet pT (GeV) above which each HLT_PFJet<path> is fully efficient.
Used for (1) the tag cut: for leg X the tag must satisfy plateau[reference(X)],
so that the reference trigger was fired by the TAG and the probe stays unbiased.
PROVISIONAL VALUES = the nominal path threshold. That is NOT the real plateau:
arXiv:2111.10431 Table 3 puts the 99.5% point at roughly 1.3-1.8x the threshold
(260 -> 362, 320 -> 430, 450 -> 592). Re-derive from the 1D turn-ons of this
analysis and replace the numbers here; the script needs no edit.
A null value disables the offline part of the cut for that path.
